usageNotes: Use this to inspect the stored configuration of a specific SDN controller (BGP, EVPN, IS-IS, or Faucet) by its identifier. Pass `pending=true` to see unapplied changes staged since the last `apply`, or `running=true` to see the live frr/dataplane config as opposed to the stored config — these two flags are mutually exclusive in practice. Requires `SDN.Allocate` on the `/sdn/controllers/{controller}` path, which is a cluster-level privilege not tied to any individual node.

examples.summary: Read configuration of a BGP/EVPN controller, including any pending (unapplied) changes

tips: If the `state` field in the response is `changed` or `new`, the controller has pending config that has not been pushed to nodes yet — run apply-sdn to activate it.
The `digest` field should be passed back in any subsequent update call to guard against concurrent modifications.

BGP-specific fields (`asn`, `peers`, `loopback`, `ebgp`, `ebgp-multihop`, `bgp-mode`, `bgp-multipath-as-relax`) are only populated for controllers of type `bgp` or `evpn`; IS-IS fields (`isis-domain`, `isis-ifaces`, `isis-net`) only appear for type `isis`.
